2609.11639.title: LoaDiff: Conditional Generation of Electricity Consumption Time Series for Energy Analytics
2609.11639.paper_summary: The energy transition is reshaping residential electricity consumption through the increasing adoption of distributed generation, electrified appliances, and demand-response programs. Understanding these evolving behaviors requires access to granular smart-meter data for applications such as load forecasting, appliance detection, and demand-side flexibility analysis. However, such data are subject to strict access restrictions and data-protection regulations. Thus, realistic synthetic alternatives are necessary. In this paper, we introduce LoaDiff, a diffusion-based generative model for year-long, sub-hourly smart-meter load curves. LoaDiff supports flexible conditioning on static household attributes, such as appliance ownership, and dynamic contextual variables, including calendar information and outdoor temperature. We evaluate the model against multiple generative baselines on three residential electricity-consumption datasets. Our experiments assess four complementary dimensions: fidelity and diversity, training-record memorization risk, downstream utility for load forecasting and appliance detection, and conditional controllability under alternative temperature conditions. The results show that LoaDiff generates realistic and diverse load profiles, achieves a favorable trade-off between generation quality and limited evidence of memorization, preserves information useful for downstream energy applications, and responds coherently to changes in conditioning variables.
2609.11639.paper_summary_zh: 能源轉型正在通過越來越多地採用分散式發電、電氣化設備和需求響應計劃來重塑住宅電力消耗。<lb/>理解這些不斷演變的行為需要訪問細粒度的智能電表數據，以便用於負載預測、設備檢測和需求側靈活性分析等應用。<lb/>然而，這些數據受到嚴格的訪問限制和數據保護法規的約束。<lb/>因此，現實的合成替代品是必要的。<lb/>在本文中，我們介紹了LoaDiff，一種基於擴散的生成模型，用於生成為期一年的子小時智能電表負載曲線。<lb/>LoaDiff支持對靜態家庭屬性（如設備擁有情況）和動態上下文變量（包括日曆信息和戶外溫度）進行靈活的條件設置。<lb/>我們在三個住宅電力消耗數據集上對該模型進行了與多個生成基準的評估。<lb/>我們的實驗評估了四個互補維度：真實性和多樣性、訓練記錄記憶風險、下游對負載預測和設備檢測的實用性，以及在不同溫度條件下的條件可控性。<lb/>結果顯示，LoaDiff生成了現實且多樣的負載特徵，實現了生成質量與有限記憶證據之間的良好權衡，保留了對下游能源應用有用的信息，並對條件變量的變化做出了連貫的反應。
